```zig title="Zig"

const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<ul><li><p>First paragraph in item.</p><p>Second paragraph in item.</p></li><li>Simple item</li></ul>", null);
```
